step1_figure.circuit_type: Source cross-coupled differential amplifier (low-power class-AB stage)
step1_figure.description: Low-power source cross-coupled differential amplifier where amplifying NMOS/PMOS devices (M1-M4 and M11-M41) have large width-to-length ratios while the biasing cascode current sources (xmisslt/b, xmissrt/b) have long channel lengths (10/20) biased by a wide-swing cascode reference (SUB_1 from Fig. 20.43) to achieve low quiescent power with high class-AB dynamic drive current.

quiescent_current_id1.description: Quiescent drain current of input transistor M1 at common-mode equilibrium (VI1 = VI2 = 1.26 V)

equation.explanation: At equal input voltages, the diff-amp is balanced and each branch carries the quiescent bias current set by the tail current source.
equation.assumptions: M1-M4 and biasing devices are matched; tail current source operating in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: With cascode tail current source (W/L = 1u/2u = 0.5) and bias generator SUB_1: I_SS = 0.5 * un*Cox * (W/L) * (VGS - Vth)^2 = 0.5 * 270u * 0.5 * (0.6 - 0.42)^2 ≈ 2.2 uA to 10 uA depending on bias levels. Typical quiescent current is ~6.5 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Designed deliberately with long L tail sources for low quiescent current as described on p. 729.

quiescent_current_id2.description: Quiescent drain current of input transistor M2 at common-mode equilibrium (VI1 = VI2 = 1.26 V)

equation.explanation: At equilibrium, symmetry dictates I_D2 equals I_D1 equals I_SS.

sky130_expected.calculation: By symmetry with I_D1,Q: I_D2,Q = I_SS ≈ 6.5 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Matches I_D1,Q at balanced common-mode bias point.

peak_output_current_id1.description: Peak output drain current of M1 under large positive differential input (VI1 high, VI2 nominal)

equation.explanation: In class-AB operation, increasing v_I1 increases V_GS of both M1 and M3 dramatically because M3's gate is held constant while its source is pulled up.
equation.assumptions: Amplifier operating in large-signal class-AB mode; M1 and M3 remain in saturation.

sky130_expected.calculation: When VI1 increases to 1.6V (ΔVin = +340mV): amplifying NMOS has W/L = 10u/0.2u = 50, beta_n = 270u * 50 = 13.5 mA/V^2. With overdrive increasing by ~0.15V, drain current surges: I_D1,max ≈ 100 uA to 200 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: As shown in Fig 22.24, current climbs past 150 uA when input is swept positive.

peak_output_current_id2.description: Peak output drain current of M2 under large negative differential input (VI1 low, VI2 nominal)

equation.explanation: When v_I1 drops significantly below v_I2, M1/M3 shut off and M2/M4 conduct peak dynamic current.
equation.assumptions: Symmetric operation in reverse differential direction.

sky130_expected.calculation: When VI1 drops to 0.9V (ΔVin = -360mV): M2 and M4 turn on strongly, yielding I_D2,max ≈ 140 uA.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Symmetric to peak I_D1 under opposite differential drive.

class_ab_boost_ratio.description: Ratio of peak dynamic drive current to quiescent bias current (I_D,max / I_D,Q)

equation.explanation: Quantifies the dynamic current enhancement of the class-AB source cross-coupled stage over static bias.
equation.assumptions: Peak current evaluated at specified differential swing (e.g. +340mV).

sky130_expected.reasoning: Baker emphasizes on p. 729 that quiescent current is a few microamps while dynamic current increases dramatically.

bias_battery_voltage.description: DC floating bias battery voltage V_bias across M11 and M41 (V(N001) - V(N1))

equation.explanation: M11 and M41 behave as biasing batteries setting the gate voltage offset between cross-coupled pairs.
equation.assumptions: Neglecting body effect and channel-length modulation.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_GS11 = Vthn + sqrt(2*Iss/beta_n) ≈ 0.42V + 0.04V = 0.46V; V_SG41 = |Vthp| + sqrt(2*Iss/beta_p) ≈ 0.42V + 0.08V = 0.50V; V_bias = 0.46V + 0.50V ≈ 0.96 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Sum of one NMOS VGS and one PMOS VSG at tail bias current Iss.

differential_transconductance.description: Effective differential transconductance Gm = d(i_D1 - i_D2)/d(v_I1 - v_I2) around equilibrium

equation.explanation: Slope of differential output current with respect to differential input voltage at equilibrium.
equation.assumptions: Small-signal operation around VI1 = VI2 = 1.26 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: G_m ≈ 2 * sqrt(beta_eq * Iss) ≈ 2 * sqrt(13.5m * 6.5u) ≈ 0.59 mA/V = 590 uA/V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Determined by effective beta of wide M1-M4 devices and Iss.

quiescent_power.description: Total quiescent power consumption of the circuit including bias network SUB_1

equation.explanation: Product of supply voltage VDD and total current drawn from VDD under quiescent equilibrium.
equation.assumptions: All inputs at DC common-mode level 1.26 V.

sky130_expected.calculation: Total supply current = I_bias_gen (~45 uA) + 2*Iss (input stages ~13 uA) + 2*Iss (output stages ~13 uA) ≈ 71 uA; P_diss = 1.8 V * 71 uA ≈ 128 uW.
sky130_expected.reasoning: Dominated by wide-swing cascode bias generator and quiescent branches.

input_cm_min.description: Minimum input common-mode voltage to maintain saturation in tail current source and cross-coupled devices

equation.explanation: Minimum input common-mode voltage keeping the tail cascode current mirror and PMOS M3 saturated.
equation.assumptions: Devices at lower boundary of active saturation.

sky130_expected.reasoning: Follows Eq. (22.43) adapted to cascode current source tail.

input_cm_max.description: Maximum input common-mode voltage before M11 or M1 enters triode

equation.explanation: Maximum input common-mode voltage limited by supply headroom and saturation of drain-connected devices.
equation.assumptions: NMOS source-follower input devices with drain at VDD.

sky130_expected.calculation: V_CMMAX ≈ VDD - V_DS,sat ≈ 1.8 V - 0.15 V ≈ 1.65 V.
sky130_expected.reasoning: NMOS input drains are tied directly to VDD, allowing wide positive input common-mode range.

step3_testbench.description: Comprehensive ngspice testbench for Baker Fig 22.24 low-power source cross-coupled diff-amp, measuring quiescent currents, peak class-AB currents, boost ratio, bias voltage, transconductance, and total quiescent power.
